sloka: तत् च रत्नम् धनुर् दिव्यम् मध्ये भग्नम् महात्मना ।रामेण हि महाबाहो महत्याम् जन संसदि ॥१-६८-९॥
transliteration: tat ca ratnam dhanur divyam madhye bhagnam mahātmanā ।rāmeṇa hi mahābāho mahatyām jana saṁsadi ॥1-68-9॥

translations.english: O King that this daughter of mine has been won by your heroic son Rama who has come here casually led by Viswamitra.
